# SIA DevTools

> Records an AI app's runs, turns reviewer-verified corrections into versioned test cases, and compares prompt versions on the same examples so a change ships only with a measured win. Local-first (SQLite, no account); optional hosted API. SIA never retrains a model and never edits code; it versions prompts.

Python SDK and CLI: pip install "sia-devtools[server] @ git+https://github.com/SrijithLegend/Self-Improving-Agent"
Local mode: SIAClient(project="...") with no key writes to sia_local.db. Hosted mode: SIAClient(api_key=..., base_url=...).
Hosted auth: Authorization: Bearer <SIA key>. Keys have scope "full" or "ingest" (ingest: send runs and feedback, read the active prompt).

## Core SDK calls

- @sia.trace / sia.start_run(name, input): record a run (input, output, latency, errors, nested steps)
- sia.feedback(run, rating, correction=...): pending feedback; sia.review_feedback(id, "verified", dataset=...) turns it into a test case
- sia.create_dataset(name).add_example(input, expected_output, critical=...): versioned datasets
- sia.evaluate(dataset, target, scorers): score a target function on a dataset
- sia.compare(baseline, candidate): paired verdict improved / no_improvement / inconclusive / regressed
- sia.create_version / approve / activate / get_prompt: versioned prompts with an explicit release step

## CLI

- sia eval gate --dataset D --target module:fn --candidate-file F: CI gate, exit 0 pass, 1 fail, 3 inconclusive
- sia improve, sia versions, sia runs, sia feedback, sia dashboard, sia serve

## HTTP API (hosted)

- POST /v1/projects/{p}/runs, POST /v1/projects/{p}/runs/{id}/feedback, /datasets, /evaluations, /comparisons, /versions
- GET /v1/projects/{p}/versions/active: the prompt production should use
